name: Dewbell Canopy
introDiscord:
High above the rootways, enormous leaves hold glowing drops of dew.
Each drop rings softly when disturbed, turning the canopy into a living
chime garden filled with drifting Dewbell Jellies.
introTwitch:
High above the rootways, enormous leaves hold glowing drops of dew.
Each drop rings softly when disturbed, turning the canopy into a living
chime garden filled with drifting Dewbell Jellies.

dewbell-canopy-approach.prompt:
Three routes cross beneath hanging dew bells. Every movement sends a
different silver note through the canopy.

left.message:
One Berry rests inside Shizuki's abandoned dew cup.

Her note reads:

'Tried playing song on dew bells.

Song became alarm.

Jellies arrived.

Music career postponed.'

right.message:
A shrine coffer hangs beneath an enormous leaf. Opening it rings three
dew bells overhead and releases Star Candies.

A surprisingly classy treasure jingle.

forward.message:
A Dewbell Jelly bumps one hanging drop.

Ding.

Another.

Ding.

Then it notices you and begins an increasingly aggressive solo.

dewbell-canopy-depths.prompt:
The canopy grows denser, and three routes pass beneath dozens of
suspended glowing bells.

left.message:
A Dewbell Jelly drifts between the hanging droplets without touching
a single one.

Then you brush a leaf.

Every bell rings.

The Jelly turns.

Apparently stealth section failed.

right.message:
A moonblossom pool gathers under the canopy beside Shizuki's note:

'Healing water.

Quiet spot.

Do NOT touch big dew drop above pool.'

The big dew drop is directly above you.
right.fullHpMessage:
You leave the pool untouched and, more importantly, leave the enormous
dew bell untouched.

forward.message:
An offering basket swings beneath a leaf like a tiny chandelier. Inside
are Star Candies that chime softly against one another.

dewbell-canopy-threshold.prompt:
Living rootways climb toward Chiming Bower, where three paths pass
through increasingly enormous dew bells.

left.message:
Broad silver kelp wraps a cache beneath a perfectly clear droplet.
Opening it releases Star Candies without ringing anything.

A flawless operation.

right.message:
A Dewbell Jelly strikes three hanging drops in perfect sequence.

The melody is beautiful.

Then it charges.

Mixed review.

forward.message:
Restorative sap sits beneath a little wooden sign:

'Concert recovery.

Audience participation got violent.'
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave Shizuki's concert-recovery supply for a future critic.

boss-antechamber.name: Chiming Bower
boss-antechamber.prompt:
Every dew bell in the Bower rings once.

Then the canopy becomes completely still.

bossPromptDiscord:
A single deep chime rolls through the forest.

The smaller Dewbell Jellies scatter from Chiming Bower as an enormous
bell-shaped shadow descends between the leaves.

Another chime follows.

Closer.

Use /yes to enter Chiming Bower or /no to leave before the midnight
performance begins.
bossPromptTwitch:
A single deep chime rolls through the forest.

The smaller Dewbell Jellies scatter from Chiming Bower as an enormous
bell-shaped shadow descends between the leaves.

Another chime follows.

Closer.

Use !yes to enter Chiming Bower or !no to leave before the midnight
performance begins.
bossRetreatText:
You withdraw beneath the canopy. One enormous bell continues tolling
softly behind you.

boss.revealText:
The hanging dew erupts into silver light as an enormous Medusa descends.

Midnight Bell Medusa reveals itself!

completionText:
"The Midnight Bell Medusa rises into the dark canopy.

The smaller dew bells resume their gentle chiming.

Shizuki's music career remains wisely postponed."
